comment: H512+PP+M's tensors as Fork's training program saves them (tools/train --arch h512ppm; idea 178's L-lower, owner 2026-11-15, architecture 12), in save order: H512+PP's (h512pp.json: 768 piece rows per own-king region of the map M4 with the factoriser merged, the 608 pawn-link rows, the output layer transposed), then the block: the side to move's exposed pieces' 640 rows (320 x enemy + 64 x kind + square seen from the perspective; the 10-input factoriser merged), hidden columns 448-511 only, row by row; read by convert.py and reference.py. The block follows the output layer in Fork's file too, and the header's input count is H512+PP's 3,680 (the block is not a first-layer row). The maps are H512+PP's, so a warm start from an H512+PP net keeps its regions and output buckets.
name: h512ppm
